title: Children's Health
desc: Immunisations, developmental check-ups, school health assessments, and bulk billing for children under 12.
detail: We are passionate about the health and wellbeing of children. Bulk billing is available for children under 12 during weekday business hours, covering vaccinations, developmental milestones, and school medicals.
fullDesc: The health of your child is our highest priority. Our GPs are experienced in all aspects of paediatric and adolescent medicine — from newborn checks and immunisations through to school-age and teenage health. We bulk bill children under 12 during weekday business hours, removing financial barriers to getting your child the care they need.
